alert.symptomBody: Call 911 immediately or go to the nearest emergency room. If there is a glucometer, check blood sugar while waiting for help.

about.title: About CareGenicsAI
about.gapTitle: The care gap in the Philippines
about.gap: Millions of Filipinos have type 2 diabetes, and many do not get regular checkups or take their medication on time. The doctor's time is short, and the cost is high when the disease worsens.
about.mission: Better Health. Stronger Finances. A Better Life.
about.berto: Berto is a voice-first diabetes care companion: medication reminder, blood glucose record, symptoms and diet, and diet advice — in Taglish. He helps doctors and families. He is not a substitute for a doctor.
about.privacy: Your records are only on this phone. As a reminder, only the medication name and time are sent to the server. When you ask Berto, only your question and the last blood glucose number are sent — no name or ID. When you speak, your voice is converted to text on Berto's server and is not saved.
about.disclaimer: Note: Berto does not provide diagnosis or medical advice. Follow your doctor's advice. In an emergency, call 911.
about.ai: Answers to free-form questions (eg "Can I eat a mango?") come from Google's MedGemma 1.5 4B, running on Berto's server for demo. There are safety rules first: emergency and medication change questions have a fixed answer and are not passed to the AI. This has not been validated by a doctor and is not medical advice.
about.aiLicense: MedGemma is covered by Google's Health AI Developer Foundations terms of use; it is not clinical-grade and is only for demo use here.
